paragraphs: Film Week Program, posted by May. The Explorers will show films in the school hall next week. The program is daily, from Monday to Friday. Every show starts at noon, and it ends before one o'clock. Teacher Kim read the program first, and she said yes. Do you want to know the films? Here is the list.

On Monday, the film is about birds in the nature park. Mia made it with her photos and a few words from Ranger Mark. It is twenty minutes long. Mia waited many hours to take those photos. After the film, Mia asks one question about the birds. Each weekday show has one fact for you to learn. On Tuesday, Leo shows three cartoons. The cartoons are about a small brown puppy. Each cartoon is five minutes long. Leo drew the cartoons at home in three weeks. Leo will draw a new picture on the screen at the end. Everyone can guess the name of the puppy.

On Wednesday, we show photos from our pen pals in Singapore. Grace, Ravi, and Nadia sent many photos of their school. Their school has children of many nationalities. Our pen pals also sent a short message for all the children. Unfortunately, the hall is not free on Wednesday. So we meet in the library, and it has only thirty seats. Please come early on Wednesday. Teacher Kim will read the message at the end.

On Thursday, the film is about our trips this year. It shows the nature park and the old town trail. The film is twenty minutes long, like the Monday film. May made the film, and the show is back in the hall. The film has a fun fact about each place. On Friday, we have the final show. It shows the best parts of the four shows. Mia, Leo, and May will say a few words before the show. The final show is forty minutes long. After the show, we have a short quiz about all the films.

At the door, a small card asks for your name and your class. Please write your class on the last line. The hall has two hundred seats, so there is room for everybody. Please do not bring food into the hall. Come early, because the first children sit in the front. Good luck to our film team! We hope that you enjoy Film Week.
text.summary: May writes the program of Film Week for Explorers' Blog. Each day has a film at noon, from Monday to Friday, and the week ends with a final show and a quiz.
